REST integration is in place without changing `BusinessLogic.cs`, `EnergyPriceService.cs`, or `PricePointDto.cs`.

### Backend (ASP.NET Core)
- **`EnergyPriceService.csproj`** — Web SDK (`Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web`).
- **`Program.cs`** — 20 POST routes under `/api/...`, each calling the matching static logic method.
- **40 request/response types** — one type per file, unique per endpoint; scalars and booleans wrapped in objects (e.g. `GetPriceResponse.Price`, `IsReadingValidResponse.Valid`).
- **`Properties/launchSettings.json`** — listens on `http://localhost:5000`.
- CORS allows `http://localhost:5173`.

### Frontend
- **`src/api.js`** — 20 `fetch` helpers with `response.ok` checks.
- **`src/App.jsx`** — on load, calls every API with sample inputs and lists each JSON result.
- **`vite.config.js`** — proxies `/api` to the backend on port 5000.

| Tariff | `determine-tier`, `calculate-tiered-cost`, `apply-time-of-use-adjustment` |
| Outage | `is-rebate-eligible`, `calculate-outage-rebate`, `estimate-restoration-time-minutes` |
| Loyalty | `calculate-loyalty-discount-percent`, `is-vip-eligible`, `reward-points-for-usage`, `apply-loyalty-discount` |

Run the API from `backend` and the Vite dev server from the project root when you are ready to try it locally.
